brief: Make money with prompt engineering. The four ways indie founders are turning prompts into recurring revenue.

slots.headline: Four Ways Indie Founders Cash In on Prompts
slots.body: Prompt engineering isn’t just a skill—it’s a revenue engine. Discover how indie founders turn clever prompts into recurring cash flow.

slots.title: Why Prompt Engineering Pays
slots.body: AI models respond to well‑crafted prompts, unlocking new products and services. Indie founders tap this skill to generate steady income streams.

slots.title: Build Prompt‑Powered SaaS
slots.body: Package a prompt‑powered SaaS, charge monthly fees, and let users solve niche problems without building their own AI models.

slots.title: Sell Prompts on Marketplaces
slots.body: Curate high‑value prompts, list them on platforms like PromptBase, and earn royalties each time a buyer downloads your prompt.

slots.title: Launch a Prompt Newsletter
slots.body: Deliver weekly prompt collections, tips, and use‑cases to subscribers; charge a recurring fee for exclusive access to proven prompts.

slots.title: Offer Prompt Consulting
slots.body: Help businesses design, test, and integrate prompts into their workflows, billing clients per project or on retainer.

slots.title: Automate & Scale Prompt Ops
slots.body: Build pipelines that auto‑generate, evaluate, and deploy prompts, turning a one‑off skill into a self‑sustaining revenue engine.

slots.headline: Start Monetizing Your Prompts Today
slots.body: Grab my free cheat sheet that walks you through building your first prompt‑based income stream.
